findings.title: The Project manager keeps only the progress figures live: a project made, deleted, moved, renamed, sealed or shared elsewhere is not drawn until the window is reopened
findings.where: scripts/projects-ui.mjs:544-568 (wireProjectManager keepFresh), 689-697 (rows from allProjects at open)
findings.what_happens: keepFresh's run walks allProjects() and rewrites the text of each [data-drpg-progress] cell it finds; nothing else of the table is redrawn. A project approved from a player's card, made by a preset, or deleted by another GM (or by the tray's row menu) keeps its rows absent or present; a room changed by a token drag (projects-map.mjs:656-679) or a share made by Observe (observe.mjs:485-489) leaves the row's select and ticks as drawn. The comment says so: "A project being CREATED or deleted elsewhere still needs the window reopening". The owner's standing rule of 20.11.2026 asks for the redraw. Save is safe against it (the room compared with the list at open, 628-629; viewers through was, projects-secrecy.mjs:492-496; rows gone skipped, 617-619), and Edit on a row deleted elsewhere opens the editor on the deleted project (finding 6).
findings.failure_scenario: A GM keeps the manager open through Daily Life, approves a player's proposal from the chat card and drags the Library barricade into the Gym: the manager shows neither the new project nor the Gym until it is closed and opened again.
findings.expected: the table redrawn in place on a project made, removed, moved or changed in who sees it, keeping the fields the GM has changed (keepLive's capture and restore)
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for any other listener on the manager's element (none in projects-ui.mjs; alreadyOpen raises it, never redraws); the keepFresh watch hears every drpg.* setting and Countdowns, but its run writes progress cells only; a store change (projectSecrets) is a client setting it does not hear at all. Save's guards were read and hold, so the harm is the display and the Edit road, not a lost write.
findings.probe: open game.drpg.manageProjects(); on a second GM create a project and drag another's token into a new room; read the manager's tr[data-project] count and the row's select value
